dogecoin.text:
I’m a Dogecoin minimalist: I own a minimal amount of Doge

Until I sell that shit for #Bitcoin that is

Confession time: yesterday I asked someone to pay me in Dogecoin because #Bitcoin transaction fees are too high for the amount and he couldn’t make it happen over Lightning.

Does this make me a bad bitcoiner?

Isn’t every alt just basically a sidechain to Bitcoin?

Financial journalism in 2021:

Thinking that a pump&dump in some illiquid asset proves that a competing larger more liquid asset with infinitely stronger fundamentals is inferior to the illiquid asset

#Bitcoin #Dogecoin
